Software Engineer - Test and Validation
Urbandale, IA

Onsite

$65K/yr - $90K/yr
RFA Engineering supports industry-leading clients with software development and engineering services for precision agriculture, machine guidance, vehicle automation, and autonomy applications. The Software Engineer - Test and Validation will test and validate software and electronic control systems for agricultural equipment, troubleshoot complex hardware and software issues, analyze test data, and collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams.
Electronics
Manufacturing
Computer
Product Design
No H1B
Responsibilities
Execute field validation and testing activities for agricultural equipment software and electronic control systems
Operate and evaluate equipment in real-world agricultural environments
Troubleshoot software, hardware, electrical, and basic mechanical issues encountered during testing activities
Collect, analyze, and document test data to identify defects, performance issues, and opportunities for improvement
Work closely with software developers, systems engineers, and test teams to reproduce, diagnose, and resolve issues
Develop and execute test plans, test procedures, and validation reports
Verify software functionality against system and software requirements
Utilize engineering tools and scripting languages to automate testing and analyze data
Support prototype machine builds, software installations, and system configuration activities
Document test results, observations, and recommendations in a clear and professional manner
Travel to customer sites, proving grounds, farms, and test locations as required
Maintain a strong focus on safety while working with agricultural machinery and test equipment

Understanding of CAN communication networks and J1939 protocols
Experience using data logging, diagnostic, or troubleshooting tools
Knowledge of Git, GitHub, or other version control systems
Experience creating automated test scripts using Python
Familiarity with software development and Agile engineering processes
